images.prompt: Edit this interface concept while retaining its product identity, lavender / off-white palette, translucent desktop frame, and charcoal type. User correction: typography is MUCH TOO LARGE and the screen is mostly text. Redesign as a realistic information-rich desktop application at 1536x1024 resolution, roughly 14px body labels, 18px compact section headings, a modest 23px page title, no huge marketing headline. Use more purposeful visual product UI, diagrams, timelines, preview thumbnails, concise data rows, and whitespace between well-defined panels. The interface should feel sophisticated and usable rather than a poster. Preserve clear hierarchy and accurate English. No real personal data or made-up benchmark statistics. Keep a small 'Interface concept' or 'Illustrative demo' label. IntervieHire: make a real-time technical interview workstation. Small left navigation; top bar 'Technical interview / Demo session'; main upper-left voice participant panel with subtle purple audio orb, compact avatar circles and microphone level meters; below a rich full-width audio waveform with alternating speaker segments and demo timestamps. Right side transcript with four short alternating interviewer/candidate exchanges in small body text. Bottom-left a visual voice pipeline with small connected nodes 'Audio → Deepgram → Interview engine → Cartesia', each with status dots; bottom-right concise session checklist 'Transcript', 'Session state', 'Turn timing'. Compact call controls and a small lower task/status rail. Prefer charts and audio visuals over explanatory paragraphs. Do not change product name or claim measured performance.
